exposure: Women who did or did not experience expulsion or removal of the IUD by one year
outcome: IUD discontinuation due to side effects
cohort: 93 women who had copper (n = 77) or levonorgestrel (n = 16) IUDs placed at the time of cesarean section
finding: The study found similar IUD locations on ultrasound at six weeks and three months postpartum for participants who did or did not experience expulsion or removal of the IUD by one year.
mod_finding: This study specifically investigated IUD placement during cesarean section and its association with expulsion or removal.
